stages.code:
import numpy as np
A = np.array([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
B = np.array([[5, 6], [7, 8]])
C = A @ B
print(C)
columns = np.column_stack([A @ B[:, j]
                           for j in range(2)])
rows = np.vstack([A[i, :] @ B
                  for i in range(2)])
assert np.array_equal(columns, C)
assert np.array_equal(rows, C)
outer = sum(np.outer(A[:, k], B[k, :])
            for k in range(2))
print("Outer-product sum:")
print(outer)
assert np.array_equal(outer, [[19, 22], [43, 50]])
stages.caption: The sum of column-times-row pieces also gives C.

A = np.array([[1., 3.], [2., 5.]])
aug = np.column_stack((A, np.eye(2)))
print(aug)
aug[1] -= 2 * aug[0]
aug[1] *= -1

assert np.allclose(A @ Ainv, np.eye(2))
stages.caption: The right half is the inverse when the left half is I.

import numpy as np
A = np.array([[0, 1, 2],
              [1, 2, 3],
              [2, 6, 9]])
P = np.eye(3, dtype=int)[[1, 0, 2]]
PA = P @ A
print("After swapping rows:")
print(PA)
L = np.array([[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [2, 2, 1]])
U = np.array([[1, 2, 3], [0, 1, 2], [0, 0, -1]])
print("PA = LU:", np.array_equal(PA, L @ U))
assert np.array_equal(PA, L @ U)
assert np.array_equal(P.T @ P, np.eye(3))
stages.caption: The source factors reproduce the permuted matrix.

print("Number of vectors:", n_vectors)

from sympy import Matrix
A = Matrix([[3, 4, 7], [2, 7, 9], [5, 2, 7]])
reduced, pivots = A.rref()
print("RREF:")
print(reduced)
basis = [A[:, j] for j in pivots]
print("Pivot columns:", pivots)
print("Column-space basis:", basis)
rank, nullity = A.rank(), len(A.nullspace())
print("Dimensions:", rank, nullity)
assert (rank, nullity) == (2, 1)
assert rank + nullity == A.cols
stages.caption: The column space has dimension 2 and the nullspace dimension 1.
